title: Fixing Slow or Empty Metrics Dashboards
content: If your dashboards are empty or loading slowly: Step 1: Ensure the time range selector is set correctly (e.g., Last 1 Hour). Step 2: Check if the selected tags and filters match active hosts. Step 3: Clear browser cache or try an incognito window to bypass local storage issues. Step 4: Verify that metrics are being received by checking the 'Data Ingestion Rate' on the settings page. Slow queries can occur if you are aggregating across millions of high-cardinality tags. Try grouping by broader tags (e.g., environment rather than container ID). If you continue to see performance degradation, try using pre-aggregated metrics dashboards.
